clue.text: Original S with martyr close to martyry

parts.note: St Alban was the first recorded British Christian martyr

indicators.note: close to means the final letter of the next word is taken

explanation.surface: Something original is joined with a martyr, close to martyrdom itself.
explanation.walkthrough: In this puzzle 'S' stands for a US state and 'Original S' for one of the thirteen founding states; each answer is that state's capital. Albany is the capital of New York.
explanation.definitionFit: Albany is the capital city of New York, one of the thirteen original colonies that became states.

clue.text: 23rd S, great area

parts.note: august means great or imposing

explanation.surface: The twenty-third state, a great big region.
explanation.definitionFit: Augusta is the capital of Maine, the twenty-third state to join.

clue.text: 43rd S, those who will be themselves, we hear?

indicators.note: we hear says the word is spoken, not spelt

parts.note: from the saying boys will be boys

explanation.surface: A state of people true to themselves, so it is said.
explanation.definitionFit: Boise is the capital of Idaho, the forty-third state.

clue.text: Catch a drink — one's hammered

parts.note: to nail someone is to catch them
punch is a mixed drink

explanation.surface: Grab a drink, as someone is drunk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'hammered' looks like slang for drunk after the drink, but literally it is struck with a hammer.
explanation.definitionFit: A nail punch is a tool struck with a hammer to drive nail heads below a surface.

clue.text: Original S reportedly no longer flying

indicators.note: reportedly says the plane's name is heard spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: Concorde, the supersonic airliner, was retired in 2003 and no longer flies

explanation.surface: An original something, it is said, has been grounded for good.
explanation.walkthrough: The plane's name ends in E; said aloud it is identical to the city's name without it.
explanation.definitionFit: Concord is the capital of New Hampshire, one of the thirteen original states of the union.

clue.text: One animal eats another with a Neapolitan ice cream

indicators.note: eats says one piece swallows the other

parts.note: a cat is an animal
an ass is another animal

explanation.surface: One animal devours another, with ice cream from Naples.
explanation.definitionFit: Cassata is a Neapolitan or Sicilian layered ice cream with fruit and nuts.

clue.text: Superb cake turned up in old African region

indicators.note: turned up in a down clue means the pieces are read bottom to top

parts.note: A1 means first-rate, with the 1 read as the letter I
a bun is a small cake

explanation.surface: A superb cake appeared in an ancient African land.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' reads A1 BUN backwards up the column: NUBIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Nubia was an ancient region along the Nile in present-day Sudan and southern Egypt.

clue.text: Getting on ain't big, ain't clever

indicators.note: not clever suggests the letters are muddled up

explanation.surface: Getting on is not a big deal, nor is it smart.
explanation.definitionFit: Obtaining means acquiring, which is what getting means.

clue.text: 38th S tragically no longer flying

definitions.meaning: the capital of Colorado, the thirty-eighth state
the singer John ... died when the light aircraft he was piloting crashed in 1997

explanation.definitionFit: The Colorado capital shares its name with the singer killed in a plane crash.

clue.text: 34th S continued being upset about old African leader

indicators.note: about says one piece goes round another
being upset in a down clue says the word is turned upside down

parts.note: kept as in kept on means continued

indicators.note: leader says the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: A state carried on being distressed about an ancient African leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being upset' turns KEPT into TPEK, which goes round O; A, the head of African, follows. Kansas was the thirty-fourth state.
explanation.definitionFit: Topeka is the capital of Kansas, the thirty-fourth state admitted.

clue.text: This pattern flattens fields in the US

parts.note: a grid is a pattern of crossing lines
irons means presses flat, as with laundry

explanation.surface: A crisscross design that presses American fields flat.
explanation.definitionFit: American football pitches are called gridirons from the pattern of lines marked across them.

clue.text: 18th S — don't get out make-up

parts.note: in cricket a batsman who is not dismissed is able to bat on
rouge is red cosmetic powder for the cheeks

explanation.surface: Advice to someone to stay in and keep their make-up on.
explanation.walkthrough: BAT ON is cricket: a batsman not given out carries on batting. Louisiana was the eighteenth state admitted.
explanation.definitionFit: Baton Rouge is the capital city of Louisiana, the eighteenth state to join the union.

clue.text: Dip falling sharply

definitions.meaning: to soak or dip it in liquid

explanation.definitionFit: One word means both to soak in liquid and having a sharp gradient.

clue.text: English mother, mother arising

parts.note: ma is a familiar word for mother
mother as an adjective, as in mother tongue or mother country, means native

explanation.surface: A list of an English mother and another mother getting up.
explanation.walkthrough: The repeated 'mother' is read two ways: the noun MA, then the adjective sense of 'mother country', NATIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Emanative describes something issuing or flowing forth, which is what arising expresses.

clue.text: Original S finally losing way, soldier claimed

indicators.note: claimed means taken in, so one piece is held inside the other
losing says a piece is taken out of the phrase

parts.note: finally can mean at last
ST, short for street, is a way
a soldier ant is a type of ant, so soldier stands for ant

explanation.surface: A founding state that eventually lost its way when a soldier took it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing' takes ST from AT LAST, leaving ATLA; 'claimed' has that take in the insect. 'soldier' looks like a military man, but a soldier ant is a caste of ant. Georgia was one of the thirteen original states.
explanation.definitionFit: Atlanta is the capital of Georgia, one of the thirteen original colonies that formed the union.

clue.text: Far-reaching agricultural conclusion applied to farm

indicators.note: conclusion says the final letter is taken

parts.note: something applied to a surface is on it
a grange is a farm with its buildings

explanation.surface: A far-reaching farming outcome put to work on a farm.
explanation.definitionFit: Long-range means extending over a great distance or time, so far-reaching.

clue.text: 28th S car

definitions.meaning: the capital of Texas, the twenty-eighth state
... was a British car maker, so an ... is a car

explanation.definitionFit: The Texan capital shares its name with the old British motor marque.

clue.text: 32nd S — I'm no devil!

parts.note: the opposite of a devil is a saint
the setter of this puzzle is Paul

explanation.surface: A state answers that the speaker is no devil.
explanation.walkthrough: Setters often refer to themselves as 'I'; this setter is Paul. Minnesota was the thirty-second state.
explanation.definitionFit: Saint Paul is the capital of Minnesota, the thirty-second state.

clue.text: One's stirring a portion of Italian — the macaroni

indicators.note: portion of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Something exciting about a plate of Italian pasta.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stirring' suggests cooking the macaroni, but it means rousing.
explanation.definitionFit: A national or rousing song is meant to stir people, so it is one that is stirring.

clue.text: 30th S — so sane is off?

parts.note: mad is the opposite of sane
on is the opposite of off

explanation.surface: Is the state so sane that it is cancelled?
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark signals that 'sane' and 'off' are turned into their opposites while 'is' stays: if mad is on, sane is off. 'so' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Madison is the capital of Wisconsin, the thirtieth state.

clue.text: Girl has to go over time

parts.note: to bridge something is to span or go over it

explanation.surface: A girl needs to cross over in time.
explanation.definitionFit: Bridget is a girl's given name.

clue.text: Black drug pusher unable to focus

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
Timothy Leary championed LSD in the 1960s

explanation.surface: A black drug dealer who cannot see straight.
explanation.definitionFit: Bleary eyes are dim and blurred, unable to focus.

clue.text: Original S with flower on

parts.note: a flower is something that flows, a river; the Trent is an English river

explanation.surface: A founding state with a flower attached.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' is a crossword standard for a river, the thing that flows. New Jersey was one of the original thirteen states.
explanation.definitionFit: Trenton is the capital of New Jersey, one of the thirteen original states.

clue.text: In the lead, go for result

parts.note: being up means ahead in a contest
a go is an attempt, or shot

explanation.surface: Ahead, so go for the win.
explanation.definitionFit: The upshot is the final outcome or result.

clue.text: Bird with separate crest

parts.note: to part is to separate
a crest is the ridge or top of a hill

explanation.surface: A bird with its own distinct crest.
explanation.definitionFit: The partridge is a game bird.

clue.text: See 10
Smack son punching sweet man?

indicators.note: punching says one piece is driven into another

parts.note: Henry Tate was a sugar refiner, of Tate and Lyle, so a sweet man; the question mark flags the loose description

explanation.surface: A son hitting a sweet man.
explanation.walkthrough: Tate and Lyle is a well-known British sugar company.
explanation.definitionFit: A smack is a slight flavour, as in 'smacks of', so it means taste.

clue.text: 33rd S has fair male

parts.note: a fair can be a sale of goods

explanation.surface: A state has a fair-haired man.
explanation.definitionFit: Salem is the capital of Oregon, the thirty-third state.

clue.text: Peaceful individual keeping element of nuclear reactor behind back

indicators.note: behind says this piece comes after the other

parts.note: hind means at the back, as in hind legs
U is the symbol for uranium, the usual reactor fuel

explanation.surface: A pacifist keeps a piece of nuclear reactor behind his back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'keeping' is only a link here. Non-violence (ahimsa) is a central Hindu principle.
explanation.definitionFit: A follower of Hinduism, a faith which prizes non-violence, is cast as a peaceful person.

clue.text: Lesser runner in last metre, collapsing

indicators.note: collapsing suggests the letters fall apart and are rebuilt

explanation.surface: A runner coming last in the final metre, falling over.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runner' looks athletic, but it is flowing water.
explanation.definitionFit: A small stream is a lesser runner, running water being a stream.

clue.text: The check contained by it

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain

explanation.surface: The restraint is held by something.
explanation.definitionFit: Therein means in that or in it, which is to be contained by it.

clue.text: Father's almond confection

definitions.note: read as father is, the 's linking the definition to the wordplay

indicators.note: confection suggests the letters are mixed and made into something new

explanation.surface: Dad's sweet made with almonds.
explanation.definitionFit: Old man is informal slang for one's father.
